                # All same - output same value
                result[i][j] = block[0]
            elif len(set(block)) == 2:
                # Two values - use max value
                result[i][j] = max(block)
            else:
                # More than 2 values - use sum mod 10
                result[i][j] = sum(block) % 10
    
    return result
